heating.name: Autoterm Comfort Controller
heating.description: Phone-controllable diesel heater controller with timer, thermostat and remote temperature sensor.
heating.notes: Worth every penny. Set your morning temperature from bed. Your partner will thank you.

heating.name: Webasto DBW 2000 Diesel Heater
heating.description: Premium diesel heater. Quiet, reliable, low 12V draw (~3A). Used in OEM VW Transporters.
heating.notes: OEM quality. Specify at conversion time — retrofitting adds cost and complexity.

heating.name: Planar 2D Diesel Heater
heating.description: Russian-made diesel heater, popular in van conversions. 2kW output, compact footprint.
heating.notes: Solid value option. Combine with Autoterm controller for phone control.

solar.name: Bimble Solar 400W Starter Kit
solar.description: Complete solar setup: 2x 200W panels, MPPT controller, cables, fixings, and instructions.
solar.notes: This is what I use. Overkill for summer, perfect for year-round wild camping.

solar.name: Victron SmartSolar MPPT 100/20
solar.description: Bluetooth-enabled MPPT charge controller. Monitors via Victron Connect app.
solar.notes: The standard for van builds. See real-time solar input from your phone.

solar.name: CTEK D250SE DC-DC Charger
solar.description: Smart DC-DC charger with MPPT solar input. The community standard for charging leisure batteries from smart alternators. 20A output.
solar.notes: Essential for T6/T6.1 smart alternators. Also has solar MPPT input — can replace a separate controller for smaller panels.

batteries.name: Bimble 100Ah LiFePO4 Leisure Battery
batteries.description: Lithium iron phosphate battery. 100Ah usable (vs ~50Ah in lead-acid). 2000+ cycle life.
batteries.notes: The upgrade that makes off-grid van life genuinely comfortable. Worth the premium.

batteries.name: Fogstar Drift 105Ah LiFePO4 Leisure Battery
batteries.description: UK-designed LiFePO4 battery. 105Ah usable, built-in BMS, Bluetooth monitoring. Compact under-seat fitment for T6.
batteries.notes: Sold direct by Fogstar; the previous Amazon listing was delisted. UK company, spec comparable to Bimble.

batteries.name: Renogy 100Ah AGM Deep Cycle Battery
batteries.description: Budget leisure battery option. 100Ah AGM, maintenance-free. ~50Ah usable capacity.
batteries.notes: Fine starting point. Upgrade to lithium when budget allows.

towbar-racks.name: Atera Strada Sport 3
towbar-racks.description: Towbar rack for 3 bikes. Swings out for barn door access. 60kg capacity. The go-to for T5/T6 barn door owners.
towbar-racks.notes: Best option for barn door setups. Swings out around the doors — no need to remove it.

towbar-racks.name: Atera Strada Sport 2
towbar-racks.description: Towbar rack for 2 bikes. Same swing-out design as the 3-bike. Lighter and more compact. 60kg capacity.
towbar-racks.notes: If you only carry two bikes, this is lighter and easier to handle than the 3-bike version.

towbar-racks.name: Atera Strada E-Bike M
towbar-racks.description: Towbar rack built for e-bikes. Reinforced arms, lower loading height. 2 bikes, 60kg capacity.
towbar-racks.notes: Purpose-built for heavier e-bikes. Lower loading height makes lifting easier.

towbar-racks.name: Atera Strada Sport E-Bike ML
towbar-racks.description: Heavy-duty e-bike rack. 2 bikes, extended arms for wider frames. 60kg capacity.
towbar-racks.notes: Extended arms for larger e-bike frames. The heavy-duty Atera option.

towbar-racks.name: Atera Vario 3
towbar-racks.description: Top-of-range Atera towbar rack for 3 bikes. Fully adjustable wheel holders, premium build. 60kg capacity.
towbar-racks.notes: The flagship Atera rack. Fully adjustable, premium materials. For those who want the best.

towbar-racks.name: Thule Velocompact 13-pin (3-4 bikes)
towbar-racks.description: Platform towbar rack for 3 bikes, extendable to 4. Tilts for boot access. 13-pin. 60kg capacity.
towbar-racks.notes: Replaces the discontinued VeloSpace XT 3 in this slot. Extendable to 4 bikes with the adapter kit; tilts down for boot access with bikes loaded.

towbar-racks.name: Thule VeloCompact 2
towbar-racks.description: Compact platform towbar rack for 2 bikes. 13-pin. Lightweight and folds flat for storage. 60kg capacity.
towbar-racks.notes: Good value Thule option. Compact when folded, easy to store in the van.

towbar-racks.name: Thule EPos 2
towbar-racks.description: Premium towbar rack for 2 bikes. Tool-free loading, fits all frame types including e-bikes. 30kg per bike.
towbar-racks.notes: The premium choice. Tool-free, fits any bike frame. No UK Amazon listing — buy direct from Thule.

towbar-racks.name: Thule Hang-On 3
towbar-racks.description: Budget towbar rack for 3 bikes. Hanging style, 45kg capacity. Simple and reliable.
towbar-racks.notes: Cheapest Thule option. Hanging design — less stable than platform racks but does the job.

towbar-racks.name: Thule Hang-On 4 (9708)
towbar-racks.description: Budget towbar rack for 4 bikes. Hanging style with tilt. 60kg capacity.
towbar-racks.notes: 4 bikes for £200 — hard to beat on value. Hanging design, less suitable for e-bikes.

door-mounted-racks.name: Thule WanderWay VW T6
door-mounted-racks.description: Premium rear-door rack for VW T6 tailgate. 2 bikes as standard, expandable to 4. 60kg capacity, 30kg per bike. Handles e-bikes.
door-mounted-racks.notes: The premium door-mounted option. T6-specific, handles e-bikes, tailgate opens with rack fitted. Expandable to 4 bikes with adapters.

door-mounted-racks.name: Fiamma Carry-Bike VW T5/T6
door-mounted-racks.description: Rear-door mounted rack for 2 bikes. Bolts to tailgate or barn doors. No towbar needed. 35kg capacity.
door-mounted-racks.notes: No towbar required. Mounts directly to the rear door. Expandable to 4 bikes with Fiamma accessories.

door-mounted-racks.name: Fiamma Carry-Bike T5/T6 Aluminium
door-mounted-racks.description: Lightweight aluminium rear-door rack for 2 bikes. 35kg capacity. No drilling, no towbar needed.
door-mounted-racks.notes: Aluminium version — lighter at 7.7kg. Easier to handle and less strain on the door hinges.

rack-accessories.name: Thule WanderWay 3rd Bike Adapter
rack-accessories.description: Adds a 3rd bike position to the Thule WanderWay. Clips onto the existing rack frame.
rack-accessories.notes: Expands the WanderWay from 2 to 3 bikes. Check weight limits — e-bikes may reduce capacity.

rack-accessories.name: Thule WanderWay 4th Bike Adapter
rack-accessories.description: Adds a 4th bike position to the Thule WanderWay. Requires 3rd bike adapter fitted first.
rack-accessories.notes: Takes the WanderWay to full 4-bike capacity. Requires the 3rd bike adapter installed.

awnings.name: Fiamma F45S Retractable Awning
awnings.description: Wall-mounted retractable awning for VW Transporters. 2.5m or 3m width. UV-stabilised canopy.
awnings.notes: The go-to choice for T5/T6. Fits tidily on the factory roof rail. No drilling required.

awnings.name: Kiravans Awning Rail Kit
awnings.description: Side-door awning rail for T5/T6. Accepts drive-away tents from Outdoor Revolution, Vango etc.
awnings.notes: Essential if you want a drive-away tent. Fits most T5/T6 — check compatibility with your tent.

awnings.name: Vango Kela V Air Low Drive-Away Awning
awnings.description: Inflatable drive-away awning for T5/T6. Fits via Kador channel or awning rail. 180–210cm fixing height. Adds a full room to the van.
awnings.notes: The most popular drive-away awning in the T6 community. Pairs with the Kiravans rail. Air beam setup — no poles needed.

insurance.name: Compare Specialist Campervan Insurers
insurance.description: One form, quotes from a panel of UK specialist campervan insurers — conversion cover, agreed value, European use. Comparison service provided by QuoteSearcher.
insurance.notes: Specialist insurers only — you're comparing like-for-like campervan policies, not standard van cover.

inspection.name: RAC Pre-Purchase Inspection
inspection.description: Independent vehicle inspection before buying. 82-point check covering mechanical, bodywork, and history.
inspection.notes: Non-negotiable for private purchases. £300 now or a £3,000 surprise later.

inspection.name: HPI Check
inspection.description: Full vehicle history check: finance outstanding, stolen, written off, mileage discrepancies.
inspection.notes: Do this before every private purchase. Never skip it — takes 5 minutes online.

bed-mattresses.name: RIB 112cm Mattress Topper
bed-mattresses.description: Foam topper sized for RIB Altair 112cm bed systems. Folds with the bed.
bed-mattresses.notes: From £118, up to £155 depending on foam depth. Select the 112cm option at checkout.

electronics-stereos.name: Kenwood DMX8021DABS Double-Din Stereo
electronics-stereos.description: Wireless CarPlay & Android Auto, DAB+, 7" capacitive touchscreen. The T6 Forum favourite. Retains steering wheel controls with adapter.
electronics-stereos.notes: Most recommended head unit on T6 Forum. Fitting kits widely available for T5.1 and T6.

electronics-stereos.name: Pioneer SPH-EVO93DAB 9" Floating Touchscreen
electronics-stereos.description: 9" floating capacitive touchscreen, wireless CarPlay & Android Auto, DAB+, HDMI input. Single-din chassis fits where double-din can't.
electronics-stereos.notes: Single-din chassis with floating 9" screen. Great for T5.1 where double-din is a tight fit.

electronics-stereos.name: Kenwood DNX9190DABS Navigation Stereo
electronics-stereos.description: HD 6.8" screen with built-in Garmin navigation, wireless CarPlay & Android Auto, DAB+. Premium option with offline maps.
electronics-stereos.notes: The premium choice if you want built-in sat nav that works without phone signal. Useful for wild camping.

electronics-projectors.name: Nebula Capsule 3 Laser Portable Projector
electronics-projectors.description: Ultra-portable laser projector (900g). Auto-focus, built-in Android TV, Netflix/Prime ready. Projects onto van side or pop-top interior.
electronics-projectors.notes: Can-sized, runs off USB-C power bank. Google TV built in. 200 ANSI lumens — fine for evening use.

electronics-projectors.name: BenQ GS50 Outdoor Portable Projector
electronics-projectors.description: Full HD 1080p, 500 lumens, splash-proof (IPX2), 2.5hr built-in battery. Premium outdoor projector with excellent colour.
electronics-projectors.notes: Brighter than Nebula at 500 lumens. Splash-proof for outdoor use. Heavier at 3.6kg but picture quality is excellent.

towbars.name: Westfalia Detachable Towbar (T6)
towbars.description: OEM-quality detachable towbar for VW T6. 2000kg towing capacity. Electrics kit sold separately.
towbars.notes: Detachable is worth the extra cost — remove it when you don't need it.
